instruction: Set the line spacing of every paragraph in the document to 1.5 lines.

parameters.window_name: 04 CHIN9505 EBook Purchasing info 2021 Jan.docx - LibreOffice Writer

command: import pyautogui; import time; pyautogui.hotkey('ctrl', 's'); time.sleep(0.5);

metadata.explanation: Task requires setting line spacing to 1.5 for all paragraphs in LibreOffice Writer. Evaluator checks if all non-empty paragraphs have line spacing of 1.5. Custom getter extracts line spacing values from all paragraphs, and custom metric verifies they all match the expected value.

llm_judge_reasons: Evaluator correctly verifies the instruction requirement: checks line spacing of all non-empty paragraphs against expected 1.5 value
Metric function correctly handles expected parameter (when type='rule', expected IS the rules dict returned by get_rule, accesses it correctly with expected.get('spacing'))
Getter logic is appropriate: extracts line_spacing from all non-empty paragraphs in the docx file and aggregates to check if all_same
Good postconfig present: includes Ctrl+S to save document before verification

Data type compatibility concern: python-docx paragraph_format.line_spacing can return None (for default/single spacing), float (e.g., 1.5), or Length object (for exact point spacing). Direct equality comparison (common_spacing == 1.5) will work if spacing is stored as float 1.5, but may fail if stored differently
Non-empty paragraph filtering (para.text.strip()) is reasonable but could miss paragraphs with formatting but no text content
llm_judge_fix_suggestions: Add type checking and conversion in getter: handle None values and Length objects from paragraph_format.line_spacing
Consider using approximate comparison in metric (e.g., abs(common_spacing - expected_spacing) < 0.01) to handle floating-point precision issues
Add logging or return more detailed failure information when all_same=False to help debug which paragraphs have different spacing
Consider checking paragraphs with para.paragraph_format instead of just para.text.strip() to catch formatted empty paragraphs
